topPRs.title: eth/090: vision-mainnet-0 U21 (OPCM v9.0.0) + OPCMUpgradeV900 skipUpgradeSuperchain option
topPRs.author: yashvardhan-kukreja
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds the Upgrade 21 (`op-contracts/v8.0.0` → `v9.0.0`) task for **vision-mainnet-0** (Vision Chain, chain id 8224) and a small opt-in change to the `OPCMUpgradeV900` template that the task needs.

**Draft:** `VALIDATION.md` currently has only the domain and message hashes. The state-change, calldata and post-execution sections are still TODO, so please don't review for approval yet.

### Task: `eth/090-U21-vision-mainnet-0`

- **Executor:** the Foundation Upgrade Safe [`0x847B5c174615B1B7fDF770882256e2D3E95b9D92`](https://etherscan.io/address/0x847B5c174615B1B7fDF770882256e2D3E95b9D92) (5-of-7), as a **single-safe** task. It owns vision's ProxyAdmin, DisputeGameFactory and SystemConfig. The standard 2-of-2 L1PAO is not involved.
- **Action:** one `OPCM.upgrade` through the `op-contracts/v9.0.0` OPCM `0x2d91e6f2bcf6cd1df90e1faf9714e18705ea331f` (9.0.3).
- **Not in the superchain-registry:** addresses come from `addresses.json` via `fallbackAddressesJsonPath`. They're sourced from devnets-private `prod/vision-mainnet-0` (`chain.yaml`, `op-deployer/intent.toml`, `state.json`) and spot-checked on-chain.
- **Proofs:** permissioned only. SUPER_PERMISSIONED (5) is the only registered game and stays respected. SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) stays disabled.
  - `cannonKonaPrestate` is the U21 standard placeholder, required non-zero by the template. It is **not** in the task calldata.
- **ETHLockbox:** the portal currently has none wired and holds 0 ETH, so the upgrade wires one and no ETH moves.

| Contract | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| SystemConfig | 4.0.0 | 4.3.0 |
| OptimismPortal2 | 5.8.0 | 6.1.0 |
| AnchorStateRegistry | 3.9.0 | 4.0.0 |
| DelayedWETH | — | 2.0.0 |

### Template: `OPCMUpgradeV900` gets an optional `skipUpgradeSuperchain` flag

vision-mainnet-0 uses the shared **Mainnet SuperchainConfig** (`0x95703e09…`). eth/084 already upgraded it to 2.5.0, and its ProxyAdmin (`0x543bA4AA…`) is owned by the 2-of-2 L1PAO, not the FUS. The template always calls `OPCM.upgradeSuperchain` first, which would revert when the FUS executes it. `OPCM.upgrade` only requires the SuperchainConfig to already be at or above the v9 version (`OPContractsManagerV2.sol:818`).

- `skipUpgradeSuperchain = true` in a task's `config.toml` makes `_build` leave out the `upgradeSuperchain` delegatecall.
- When the flag is set, `_templateSetup` requires `SuperchainConfig.version() == "2.5.0"`, so a task can't skip an upgrade that is still pending.
- Default is `false`. Existing tasks are unchanged.

---

## For Task PRs

**Task path**: `src/tasks/eth/090-U21-vision-mainnet-0`

**Tenderly simulation link**: https://www.tdly.co/shared/simulation/f8438494-cd0a-475f-933f-14a487e8b7f5

`just simulate-stack eth 090-U21-vision-mainnet-0` passes locally (2026-11-17), stacked after the pending eth/085, eth/086 and eth/087:
- Domain hash `0xa4a9c312badf3fcaa05eafe5dc9bee8bd9316c78ee8b0bebe3115bb21b732672`
- Message hash `0xbee18d211daf2bc83e60f4385a90652ed89c61d878753da77f84266daba2e9ea`
- Validator output: `OVERRIDES-L1PAOMULTISIG,OVERRIDES-CHALLENGER,SCKDG-SHAPE,SCKDG-10`. All four are expected: the owner is the FUS rather than the standard L1PAO, the challenger is the chain's own, and there is no SUPER_CANNON_KONA game.

### Simulation Checklist

> These boxes must be checked before your PR can be merged.

- [ ] I have run a Tenderly simulation for this task
- [ ] I have reviewed and understand all state changes in the simulation
- [ ] I have verified that every state change reflects the **exact expected value** (e.g., if setting an `absolutePrestate`, confirm the precise `bytes32` hash matches expectations)
- [ ] All state changes match the expected behavior documented in `VALIDATION.md`
- [ ] I can explain every state diff to reviewers and signers

### Task Checklist

- [ ] `README.md` is complete with accurate task description
- [ ] `VALIDATION.md` documents expected state changes with correct domain/message hashes
- [ ] Task status is set appropriately
- [ ] All TODOs in generated files have been addressed

---

## Additional context

- **Nonce:** the FUS nonce is pinned at **83**: 80 live on 2026-11-17, plus one each for eth/085, eth/086 and eth/087, which use the FUS and execute first. If that order changes, or other FUS transactions land first, the nonce and hashes must be regenerated.
- **Template test coverage:** the `skipUpgradeSuperchain` path still needs a regression case in `test/tasks/Regression.t.sol`. TODO before un-drafting.
- **Lockbox:** devnets-private `state.json` lists an `EthLockboxProxy` (`0x4A13f8d1…`) that the portal does not point at. The state diff will show whether the upgrade reuses it or deploys a new one; `VALIDATION.md` must document whichever happens.

topPRs.title: sep/111 + eth/075: Soneium SystemConfig owner to Foundation Upgrade Safe
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Transfers ownership of the Soneium Minato and Soneium Mainnet `SystemConfigProxy` from the Soneium SystemConfig owner Safes to the Foundation Upgrade Safe, ahead of the Soneium migration cutovers. Each task is a single `SystemConfig.transferOwnership(address)` call executed by the current owner: `0xB278818732E5BEbb742dc4Aa0617ccd1Dec76b65` (2-of-5) on Minato and `0x509182eC226b3B71D36A3255A80EF0b1A9D43033` (3-of-5) on Mainnet.

Same template and shape as #1560 (Unichain) and eth/065 / sep/104 (Ink): `TransferSystemConfigOwnership` with `safeAddressString = "SystemConfigOwner"`, so the signer is the owner discovered on-chain. SystemConfig 4.0.0 is single-step `Ownable`, so the transfer is effective on execution.

| Task | SystemConfigProxy | New owner | Nonce pin |
|---|---|---|---|
| sep/111 | `0x4Ca9608Fef202216bc21D543798ec854539bAAd3` | `0xDEe57160aAfCF04c34C887B5962D0a69676d3C8B` (Sepolia FUS) | 32 |
| eth/075 | `0x7A8Ed66B319911A0F3E7288BDdAB30d9c0C875c3` | `0x847B5c174615B1B7fDF770882256e2D3E95b9D92` (FUS) | 22 |

Nonces are the live values on 2026-10-01; calldata and domain/message/safe hashes were re-derived independently with `cast` and match `just simulate-stack`. Both tasks stay DRAFT until the execution dates are fixed; the hashes move if the owner Safes sign anything else before then.

topPRs.title: [CONTINGENCY] eth/088: Soneium Mainnet rollback of batcher + unsafe block signer
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Contingency rollback for the Soneium Mainnet sequencer + batcher cutover in #1566. Kept as a separate PR and merged only if it is needed, same as the Ink rollback in #1493.

`eth/088` restores Sony's batcher `0x6776BE80dBAda6A02B5F2095cF13734ac303B8d1` and unsafe block signer `0x7c2Bd59ee2a2C7391c9A240132f26071e9546262` (the live values before `eth/085`) on the Soneium `SystemConfigProxy`, signed by the FoundationUpgradeSafe, which stays the SystemConfig owner. The proposer has no rollback: the OPE proposer (`eth/084`) keeps working whichever party runs the sequencer and batcher.

It is pinned to FoundationUpgradeSafe nonce 82, so it can be signed ahead of the Nov 19 ceremony and executed within minutes. That nonce is shared with the foundation approval of `eth/086` (fee vaults), so only one of the two can execute. `eth/086` should be executed only once the cutover is confirmed. If the rollback executes instead, `eth/086` and every later FUS task (`eth/087`) move up by one nonce and are re-signed. The status is `CANCELLED (CONTINGENCY TASK, SIGN AS NEEDED)` so `fetch-tasks.sh` leaves it out of the stacked simulation, where the shared nonce would otherwise fail the nonce check. It is simulated on its own, with state overrides for the post-`eth/085` owner, batcher and signer.

The calldata is `eth/085`'s with Sony's two addresses swapped in, checked byte for byte and decoded with `cast`. The standalone simulation passes, and the hashes in VALIDATION.md come from it.
